# Doxis: Cloud, on-premises & hybrid

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/9/flexibility-76kemkn1re7r2yw.svg)

Flexible deployment

Deploy Doxis your way: on-premises in your own data center, in the cloud, or a combination of the two.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/8/managed-services-6nt8hs73ktmkh8w.svg)

Custom-fit licensing models

The choice is yours: Unlimited licenses or subscription-based — deploy Doxis independently or use the managed services from SER

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/5/workflow-process-automation-eqrys23vddrrjz0.svg)

Multi-platform technology

Doxis runs on your existing infrastructure: It supports a variety of operating systems, databases and (cloud) storage providers

### Tailored to your IT

You have the freedom to choose — after all, the technology and functional scope are the same in any case: The Doxis Cloud drives your digitalization to the next level — launch immediately with unlimited scalability on a leading public cloud platform. Parallel to this, Doxis on-premises consolidates your existing IT infrastructure and even cuts down on costs. Or choose the hybrid approach and take advantage of the benefits of both options.

[Doxis-as-a-service\\
\\
Create solutions with our comprehensive cloud platform for ECM, BPM and collaboration without having to manage your own server hardware and complex IT tasks and no high initial investments. The Doxis Cloud offers the highest level of security, scalability and availability while providing maximum financial and technological flexibility. You profit from fully scalable solutions and are always state-of-the-art thanks to automatic updates.\\

Learn more about the Doxis Cloud](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/saas)

Doxis in your data center

Do you have a big IT team and your own data centers? Then it might make sense to run and maintain your Doxis-based enterprise content management, process and collaboration solutions together with other applications in your own data center. In this situation, Doxis supports all important operating systems, database technologies and storage solutions.

## Multi-platform support

### Server operating systems

- Windows Server x64
- Linux (SLES, RedHat)
- Unix (AIX)
- Additional systems on request

### Application server

- Wildfly
- JBOSS EAP
- IBM Websphere
- Additional systems on request

### Databases

- Oracle
- Microsoft SQL Server
- PostgreSQL
- IBM DB2

### Virtualization

- VMware
- Docker
- Citrix
